notes.title: [v0.30.20] Beta May Big Update and August Update Plan
notes.notes:
Monthly Big Updates Small Updates Promise
While it's been said that the VUP Simulator has been defer, it ends here now! Every month there will be a big content update and several small updates (bug) fixes and so on!


Multilingualization
I'm sorry to say that the game is still in the early to mid stages of development, and a lot of the text has not been written. In addition, this system is actually earlier than the table favor, the translation structure is basically not. So I guess we'll have to wait until the preview stage (it's still in beta) to see if we'll be able to implement multilingualism.
In the future, there will definitely be multi-language, currently has access to multi-language plug-ins (table favor with the same model), will slowly access multi-language.


June UpdatesJune Update: Nili Commenting System
Nili now supports a commenting system, and with the addition of the Smart Lolis AI, both player and NPC videos will now have comments!

fun

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821782/95cdfb1f33b32aa31907740d16d655c5c1f88fdc.png"]

no fun

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821782/724128a1840e002db6f6c444fbd8a6cd36e1c8ad.png"]



And it will calculate the hidden score according to the title and description, if you post a video, you like to keep the default time name (2200-01-01), now there will be a poor video plays and data

Canceled - Event AI Generation: Since the event system is going to be redone, and the AI generated events are actually mediocre, it's better to let the planner write them. Event related production has been canceled.
June Minor UpdatesNili Video provides a display of video duration and resolution.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821782/ab8472b7ceceb2afad5f3953038107a1dad0b6f2.png"]

Improved some of the UI alerts.

Popup alerts for hunger/sleep deprivation

Drug related implementation and support

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821782/7665eea87293e3b40b363ee4ea6bddaeaafb31e1.png"]

Optimize skip logic: auto terminate and auto sleep

Fixed the error that may be caused by missing pictures

Updated file browser to support viewing attributes

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821782/274fd61d1e21e469a9e1e71f6130b6f80f7d70a4.png"]

Attribute Viewing Support: Items. Video,Food,L2D

Add all food column, you can see all the food you have.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821782/d14537348f40c0dedae2b8c3f04610f9423922ad.png"]

Fix NILI bug that generates poor reviews

Nili review interface

Update review extraction user logic


July Update ProgramJuly Update: Love Learning
A lot of people have told me that the short video editing in VE Clips doesn't work, is it because they haven't done it, but it's just that their character attributes don't meet the requirements.

Now with Love Learning, players can learn a variety of skills through classes, and be able to use a variety of high-end editing skills and eloquence and other functions.
July Minor Updates.
Bug fixes: For example, I've heard that there are problems with the old artist's assignments, so I'll look into it later.

Sound: Currently using my own sound effects or win11 sound mods, want to make some better sound effects, back to research to see

Other: I don't think there's much to write about, if you have any suggestions for updates, please feel free to comment!

 
Game Feedback

The fourth round of testing is a bit of a game, but the content is very poor, the core gameplay (virtual tuber, etc.) has not been realized, please bear with me!
If you encounter bugs or errors, please contact customer service email service@exlb.net

notes.notes:
Monthly Big Updates Small Updates Promise
While it's been said that the VUP Simulator has been goo, it ends here now! Every month there will be a big content update and several small updates (bug) fixes and so on!

Multilingualization
I'm sorry to say that the game is still in the early to mid stages of development, and a lot of the text has not been written. In addition, this system is actually earlier than the table favor, the translation structure is basically not. So I guess we'll have to wait until the preview stage (it's still in beta) to see if we'll be able to implement multilingualism.
In the future, there will definitely be multi-language, currently has access to multi-language plug-ins (table favor with the same model), will slowly access multi-language.

May's update
May's big update: Old Artist
Old Painter is now complete (basic features are now loaded).
Here are some screenshots of the game: The Artist Page
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821782/841634da05363802e6fbd1997833347c6f2f69c4.png

Players can now make appointments and improve their L2D risque models in the Veteran Artist
May Minor Updates
Fixed bug where command line programs were not executed

 Fixed the problem that some software (Software Center) opens slowly and gets stuck.
 Changed to UI queue to reduce possible UI thread lag on low performance computers.
 Avatar generation consistency
 Bug fixes * 5
 Support for modifying table favor scaling and other settings
 Eating doesn't get stuck at the end and prevent you from doing other things
 Extremely large part-window performance boost (switched to Visual virtual loading to reduce game performance requirements)


June update program
June Update: Accessing the Smart Lolis AI Server
My new graphics server arrived, the one used to train ChatVPet table pets to talk.
However, at present there is no need to train, and I intend to use it to improve gameplay. When there is enough data, it can also be changed to offline keyword/machine learning judgment.
Scope of access and examples

 nilinli video: determine if the title and introduction of the video is funny/interesting/attractive, etc., and decide how much the video will be played.
 Events: randomly generate events based on difficulty, try it first, it's fun!

Small update in June: Improvements to the file manager.
Foods can be viewed in all food items.
You can simply see the item information from the sidebar, so you don't have to use the attribute panel.
Make a whole lot of medicines, and add some health to them.

Game Feedback

The fourth round of testing is a bit of a game, but the content is very poor, the core gameplay (virtual tuber, etc.) has not been realized, please bear with me!
If you encounter bugs or errors, please contact customer service email service@exlb.net
